status: planner choices for approval; no case-study prose or statistics authored
source_policy: Listed URLs are verified primary leads, not proof that every proposed teaching claim is supported. The author must read and cite a primary source for each real-place fact before writing. Empty URL lists require source acquisition within the assigned case; do not invent facts or silently substitute a different case.

entries.case_selection: 2011 Tohoku earthquake and tsunami; Mayon 2018 as the volcano example
entries.required_teaching: Formation, distinct earthquake/volcano effects, vulnerability, management; dated figures only after source reading.

entries.case_selection: Zambezi floodplain and Cuvelai oshanas, Namibia
entries.required_teaching: Opportunities, flood risks and wetland management; avoid treating all floodplains as uniformly sparse or dense.
Coastal opportunities, sediment transport and management; use original teaching maps/data, not invented measurements of a real beach.

entries.case_selection: Namib Desert vegetation; Amazon rainforest clearance; East African savannah
entries.required_teaching: Adaptation linked to conditions; clearance causes/effects and management; source date-specific deforestation figures before use.

entries.case_selection: Fishing economies of Walvis Bay and Lüderitz
entries.required_teaching: Primary/secondary/tertiary links, physical conditions, threats, quotas, processing location and agglomeration.

entries.case_selection: Northern Namibian subsistence farming; central commercial livestock; maize triangle
entries.required_teaching: Inputs, processes, outputs, locational factors, food supply and sustainable strategies; do not invent production statistics.

entries.case_selection: Etosha tourism and community-conservancy tourism, Namibia
entries.required_teaching: Benefits, costs, seasonality, environmental protection and local perspectives. Hypothetical questionnaires/data must be clearly fictional internally.

entries.case_selection: Ruacana HEP and Namibia’s regional energy links
entries.required_teaching: Location, generation, seasonal constraints, source trade-offs and policy. Avoid unsupported current capacities.

entries.case_selection: Windhoek water supply and demand management
entries.required_teaching: Water sources, competing uses, treatment/recycling, shortages and pollution; use city/utility facts with dates.
Wildlife economic/environmental effects, land-use conflicts, stakeholder roles and qualified judgements of success.

entries.case_selection: Namibia 2023 Census; historical China/Japan population-policy examples
entries.required_teaching: Distribution, age structure, growth, migration and policy consequences. Historical policy details require dated primary evidence; no present-tense claims from old textbook descriptions.

entries.case_selection: Namibia HIV demographic and socioeconomic impacts
entries.required_teaching: Use WHO/UNAIDS definitions and a clearly dated official dataset; avoid inferring current prevalence from an old exam extract.

entries.case_selection: Windhoek urban growth and informal-settlement improvement; an explicitly schematic MEDC contrast
entries.required_teaching: Residential structure, services, congestion, housing and environment. A schematic model is not a measured map or a universal LEDC/MEDC rule.
